description: This file, EmailQueue.php, handles queuing email messages for a campaign in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It retrieves prospects associated with a campaign, constructs email objects, and schedules sending by saving the email records with specified parameters.

classes.name: EmailMan
classes.description: Represents an email message to be sent, with properties for module, module_id, user_id, list_id, template_id, from_name, from_email, and send_date_time.

classes.name: Campaigns
classes.description: Campaign bean representing a marketing campaign, retrieved using its ID.

classes.name: ProspectLists
classes.description: Prospect list bean representing a group of prospects, retrieved by ID.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a bean record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: db->query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result resource.

methods.name: db->fetchByAssoc
methods.description: Fetches a row from the query result as an associative array.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the email message object to the database, scheduling the email for sending.

methods.name: headerRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the browser to the specified URL.
